Overview

The project.

Media image, Media video · Jul 2020 — Dec 2021

37 photos and 3 videos made for Agramix's social media and promotions between 2020 and 2021: square and wide banners for products, offers and agricultural equipment, two printed flyers, and short video ads presenting the product range.
